indicator_definition: Index tracking changes in common bird populations across Europe using 1990 as base year (= 100). Birds are sensitive indicators of ecosystem health. Data compiled from national breeding bird surveys.
rationale: Declining bird populations signal habitat degradation. Progress means halting and reversing the decline in common bird populations.
methodology_characteristics: Data compiled from national breeding bird surveys via the Pan-European Common Bird Monitoring Scheme (PECBMS). Index aggregates trends for representative species. Published annually.
